description: task-gopher — SessionStart injects the full Haiku-delegation directive on startup, resume, clear, and post-compaction (so it survives compaction); UserPromptSubmit injects a compact reminder each turn; PreToolUse enforces the subagent relay whenever ON (Agent dispatches missing the directive sentinel are bounced with the directive in the deny reason, since SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit never fire for subagents) and, in strict mode, additionally blocks the first direct retrieval of each turn as a consider-task-gopher checkpoint. All are no-ops unless the plugin is toggled ON.
